# netskope_device_classification_rule_list (Data Source)

DeviceClassificationRuleList DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_device_classification_rule_list" "my_deviceclassificationrulelist" {
  label  = "...my_label..."
  limit  = 5
  offset = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `label` (String) Filter to only rules belonging to the named label
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of items to retrieve
- `offset` (Number) Zero-based offset of the first item to retrieve

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `conditions` (String) Nested boolean condition tree. Structure uses $and/$or operators containing check nodes (e.g. min_os_version_check, av_check, file_check, domain_check). Checks must appear at the fourth level or deeper (minimum: $and > $and > $or > check). Parsed as JSON.
- `label` (String) Label (tag) name this rule belongs to
- `name` (String) Rule name (unique within its label)
- `os` (String) Operating system this rule applies to
- `rule_id` (Number) Rule ID
